reason: Our agent volume on the MCP server is tiny today, and no regulator has written a rule or brought an enforcement action that says I need agent passports or a gate like this. I don't spend compliance budget on what a whitepaper says is coming.
objection: You want me to put a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 as a proxy in the path of every trade and payment on a crypto venue. If it goes down or gets breached, that's my outage and my exam finding, and AINRA isn't a standard anyone examining us has asked about.
would_change_my_mind: A written rule, guidance or enforcement action from the SEC, CFTC or NYDFS that holds a venue responsible for controls on customers' AI agents, plus a finished SOC 2 Type II.
